newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB files for US$862.5 mln issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB files for US$862.5 mln issue.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd and its wholly-owned subsidiaries National Australia Capital Securities (UK) Plc and National Australia Capital Securities (Jersey) Ltd said they have filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to raise up to US$862.5 million.
The issue comprises US$750 million as previously announced on November 29 and an over-allotment option of US$112.5 million.

The bank said funds raised would be through exchangeable capital units. "The National has developed this capital instrument together with Merrill Lynch which has been named as the lead manager of a syndicate which will include Morgan Stanley, Cazenove and Co and UBS Ltd," NAB said.

The bank said the capital raising was designed to provide National with greater flexibility to manage its capital, improve access to international capital markets, and broaden the investor base consistent with its international expansion.
